findings.title: Liveness probe kills the container
findings.cause: container proxy fails its startup probe (GET /ready on port 15021), so the kubelet restarts it (7 restarts); it is a sidecar (an init container with restartPolicy: Always), and the containers after it start only once its startup probe passes, so container web never starts; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: Startup probe failed: Get "http://10.244.0.202:15021/ready": dial tcp 10.244.0.202:15021: connect: connection refused
Init container proxy failed startup probe

findings.fix: Point the probe at a port and path the app serves, or give it a startupProbe or longer initialDelaySeconds if it starts slowly.
